name: Key In Chiron
hook: Left the keys in a 3-million-dollar hypercar again
tagline: A CEO casually parks his multi-million hypercar with the keys dangling in the ignition as shady opportunists slowly creep out of the bushes. Cashing out locks the doors with a chirping alarm and speeds off into the sunset. Crashing lets a masked joyrider smash the pedal and blast away in a cloud of burnt rubber.
